conversations.name: Carlo
conversations.snippet:
to meet you. My name is Carlo, I’m Italian and I’m 32 years old. I’m writing because I’m interested in the room in Brisbane.
I recently quit my job and I’m coming to Australia to learn English. At the same time I’ll also need to work, as I’m arriving with a 417 visa, so I hope to find a job as soon as possible.
In Italy I owned a small retail shop, similar to a mini market, and also a service agency. For example, I helped people open bank accounts, send parcels all over the world, pay bills, and other similar services.
Unfortunately, what I was doing in Italy isn’t very useful in Australia, so I’ll have to start from zero, both with the language and with work.
I hope it’s not a problem for you to deal with someone who doesn’t speak English very well yet. Maybe you could even help me improve.
I would arrive between March 22 and March 31. I can’t give you an exact date because the conflicts in Iran are causing major problems with flights. As soon as I manage to organize a flight, I’ll let you know.
